title: Best robot vacuum deal: Save $270 on Shark AV2501S AI Ultra
excerpt: It has a bagless, self-emptying design.
content_html:
SAVE $270: As of Nov. 3, the Shark AV2501S AI Ultra robot vacuum is on sale for $279.99 at Amazon. That's a 49% discount on the list price.

Credit: Shark

$279.99 at Amazon
$549.99 Save $270

Black Friday deals are already appearing, and robot vacuums are among the products getting early discounts.

If you've been thinking about letting a machine take care of the floors for you, there's already a decent saving to be had on the Shark AV2501S AI Ultra at Amazon. As of Nov. 3, the price has dropped from $549.99 to $279.99, saving you $270 – almost half the usual price.

The best tech deal this week

One of the biggest selling points is its self-emptying, bagless base, which can hold up to 30 days of dirt and debris before needing to be emptied manually. It's also a great option for pet owners, thanks to its strong suction and self-cleaning brushroll, which help tackle pet hair.

Battery life shouldn't be an issue for most homes, either. The vacuum can run for up to 120 minutes before returning to its base to recharge. It also remembers where it stopped, so it can pick up where it left off once it's ready to go again.
